studyInfo: Mouse skin graft tissue collected at 24 h and 72 h after transplantation, spanning wild-type (wt), littermate control (litt), and Cre-mediated experimental groups. This dataset captures early and intermediate phases of graft response, including immune infiltration, fibroblast activation, vascular remodeling, and epidermal regeneration. Spatially resolved transcriptomics (Xenium) profiling enables cell type–specific analysis of inflammatory, metabolic, and regenerative programs across distinct graft compartments and genotypes to dissect cellular mechanisms underlying graft integration and immune response.
